# M14 Varro's Gambit (province: the Aurean shore, the Consul's camp Castra Maxima): storm the camp, take Varro's HQ 2 (38,12) or rout his army. Three lanes: the coast road (south, over the river's mouth bridge), the river valley (centre road beside the moat river, gate bridge), the ridge track (north, through Cassius's hill camp to the north gate). Army 3 (Cassius, Yellow Comet, HQ (21,4) on the ridge plateau) is hostile to both until day 4 (mission code), then fights for the player. Start forces: player INF4 MECH3 TANK3 MDT2 RECON1 ART2 AA1 (16), funds 6000; Varro INF5 MECH2 TANK4 MDT3 ART3 ROCK1 AA1 MIS1 FTR1 RECON1 (22, of which INF3 ART3 ROCK1 hold) + reserves on days 5 and 8 at the camp's east road; Cassius TANK3 RECON2 MDT1 INF2 (8). Threat/answer: Varro's Fighter -> AA and Missiles in the player's reinforcements and the player's AA on the road, woods cover; entrenched Artillery and Rockets behind the wall (range 3..5) -> Recon to find them, Tanks close fast through the gates, own Artillery behind the moat; Md Tank counter-attacks from the gates -> own Tanks/MDT, bridges are the choke; Cassius's early tank rush on the ridge track -> hold the ridge pass with Tanks and ART until he changes sides.
